units: <cite ref="Bava Kamma 59a:15">B. Kam. 59ᵃ</cite> <he>נכי חיה</he> payment is made with a deduction of the expense for the midwife (which the husband now saves); <he>נ׳ מזונות</he> a deduction for nursing expenses (incident to a regular confinement). Y. ib. VIII, beg. 6ᵇ <he>נותנין נכאי מזון</he> the injured person must be fully indemnified, deducting what his ordinary alimentation would have cost; Tosef. ib. IX, 3 <he>נכי מזון</he> Var. (ed. Zuck. <he>דמי ניזק</he>, oth. var. <cite ref="G00455"><he>זכי</he></cite>, <he>זבי</he>, corr. acc.).
